source_segments.text: Cosimo II de' Medici, Grand Duke of Tuscany Cosimo II de' Medici (12 May 1590 – 28 February 1621) was Grand Duke of Tuscany from 1609 until his death.
He was the elder son of Ferdinando I de' Medici, Grand Duke of Tuscany, and Christina of Lorraine.
For the majority of his twelve-year reign, he delegated the administration of Tuscany to his ministers.
He is best remembered as the patron of Galileo Galilei, his childhood tutor.
Cosimo's father Ferdinando I took care to provide him with a modern education.
Indeed, Galileo Galilei was Cosimo's tutor between 1605 and 1608.
